{{Quote|These security droids are the property of Banking Clan executives holding citizenship on Aargau. As per the Aargau Charter, citizenry are constitutionally mandated to be armed; this extends to the use of combat automata to those whose liquid assets afford them Premium Citizenship.|Lo Vapeet, on the status of IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks owned by Inter-Galactic Banking Clan executives on Aargau|<ref name="Insider 65">{{InsiderCite|65|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:2:14 Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Premium Citizenship''' was a class of citizenship that could be accorded to residents of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Premium Citizenship was awarded only to Aargau citizens who held sufficient liquid assets. Among the rights that Premium Citizenship conveyed was entitlement to use [[Battle droid/Legends|combat automata]] on Aargau, as an extension of the constitutional right of Aargau citizens under the [[Three Statutes of Aargau|Aargau Charter]] to bear arms.<ref name="Insider 65" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Lo Vapeet]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Inter-Galactic Banking Clan]] argued that [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]] produced by the IBC on Aargau were the lawful property of IBC executives based on the world, due to the Premium Citizenship status that the executives held.<ref name="Insider 65" />
